items.t: Retractable hardtop stops partway or won't move
items.job: Diagnose roof system; replace a position sensor or service the hydraulic pump
items.note: Often a sensor adjustment or fluid top-up. A new pump, cylinder or roof module costs much more.

items.t: Roof panel separates from the frame
items.job: Re-bond or replace the front roof panel
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $3,500 on average. A lost panel can be hard to source.

items.t: Hydraulic fluid leak from the roof cylinders or lines
items.job: Replace leaking roof hydraulic cylinder or line and refill

items.t: Gasoline smell or fuel leak from the tank lines
items.job: Replace fuel tank crossover pipe, feed line or connectors
items.note: Owners report $2,300 and more because the tanks must come out. Ask a dealer if the quick-connector campaign applies.

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong or drops to empty
items.job: Replace fuel level sending unit
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $2,240–$2,873 for this job on the XLR.

items.t: Engine oil leaks from the Northstar V8
items.job: Reseal lower crankcase and oil pan
items.note: A front cover or small seal leak costs much less. Engine-out reseals are the high end.

items.t: Shift cable breaks so the car won't shift or stays in gear
items.job: Replace transmission shift cable

items.t: Shifter won't come out of Park at times
items.job: Diagnose and repair shift lock or brake switch

items.t: Headlights or running lights melt, fog up or fail
items.job: Replace headlamp or running lamp assembly (one side)
items.note: New lamps are scarce; used or rebuilt units are common. CarComplaints owners report about $3,000 for both sides.

items.t: Turn signal and running light bulb burns out early (recall)
items.job: Replace lamp sockets and bulbs (recall)

items.t: Rear brake lines can overheat from the exhaust (recall)
items.job: Reroute or replace rear brake lines (recall)

items.t: Lower control arm ball joint nut can loosen (recall)
items.job: Replace ball joint nut and washer (recall)

items.t: Engine may not return to idle in extreme cold (recall)
items.job: Replace accelerator pedal assembly (recall)

items.t: Cracked or broken composite leaf spring
items.job: Replace front or rear composite leaf spring

items.t: Leaking shocks or 'Service Suspension' warning
items.job: Reseat suspension connector or replace one Magnetic Ride shock
items.note: Reseating the connector costs only diagnosis time. A new magnetic shock is several hundred dollars or more.

items.t: StabiliTrak brakes a wheel or the rear steps out unexpectedly
items.job: Diagnose stability system; replace steering wheel position or wheel speed sensor
items.note: RepairPal lists a failed steering wheel position sensor as a common XLR cause of stability warnings.

items.t: Brake rotor surface cracks
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Front brakes squeal under light braking
items.job: Replace front brake pads with updated pads

items.t: Run-flat tires wear fast, bubble or are costly to replace
items.job: Replace one run-flat tire, mount and balance
items.note: An owner reported about $415 per tire.

items.t: Doors won't open with a dead battery or failed fob
items.job: Replace 12V battery and test door release system

items.t: Driver door won't open from the outside touch pad
items.job: Replace driver door touch pad switch or latch actuator
items.note: RepairPal lists door lock actuator replacement at about $315–$372.

items.t: No start from steering column lock fault
items.job: Diagnose and replace steering column lock module

items.t: Water in the trunk or passenger footwell
items.job: Clear roof drains and reseal leak; dry carpet

items.t: Ratcheting or clicking noise on cold start
items.job: Diagnose cold-start noise per GM bulletin

items.t: Blue smoke at startup
items.job: Diagnose oil consumption and valve seal leakage

items.t: Rear axle chatter or clunk on turns
items.job: Drain and refill rear differential fluid with additive

items.t: Telescoping steering wheel won't adjust
items.job: Repair or replace power steering column motor or switch

items.t: Power steering fluid leak at the pump hose
items.job: Replace power steering pressure hose or seal
